title: A Strawberry Database: Geometric Properties, Images and 3D Scans
notes: Nongtori field Weight_g is measured with the strawberry calyx attached. Therefore Dryad weight_with_calyx is the canonical weight target and weight_without_calyx is auxiliary analysis only. Local research credentials use the common TORI .env.local file (DRYAD_CLIENT_ID / DRYAD_CLIENT_SECRET); the acquisition helper mints a short-lived access token automatically, downloads the target file, and verifies size/SHA-256. DRYAD_TOKEN is an optional one-off override only. Before APPROVED: run the real datasheet audit, prove image filename to fruit ID join, require complete with-calyx GT, and split strictly by fruit identity so the 22 views of one berry never cross train/validation/test.
